verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers a beta business bank account and a Money Dashboard, so a self-service transaction-limit increase request is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions transaction limits, cards, or any way to request a limit increase. The bank account and cash-flow evidence describes adjacent features and earns no credit toward this story.
